snippet.title: Blood of Rations — WW2 Extraction Shooter | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Blood of Rations is a WW2 extraction shooter — solo PvPvE raids across 1944 occupied Europe. Slip alone into a war-torn Europe to scavenge what the dead left behind. Hunt loot. Fight strangers. Extract alive — or lose it all. Every raid begins in your warm, safe bunker. If you're lucky, it ends there too.

No minimap. All-diegetic audio. A grid inventory where every slot is a decision. An 8-second extraction window. Early Access on Steam, 5 November 2026.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4792260/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=trailer
Official site: https://bloodofrations.com
Studio: https://arcticsquarestudio.com

#WW2 #ExtractionShooter #PvPvE #IndieGame
